gate: Rehman POP66 genetic carrier persistence layer
reason_postresult: The source paper's genetic-selection conclusion is known and a few SSM rows were inspected during source qualification; this gate cannot become P1 confirmation.

mutation_rows.include: all combined POP66 SSM mutation rows except source-declared garbage IDs
mutation_rows.zero_total_reads: refuse row if any required sample has total_reads <=0

metrics.primary: RMS VAF deviation from frozen baseline centroid across all retained mutations
secondary: median absolute VAF deviation from baseline centroid
metrics.descriptive_carrier_gate: regrowth must be closer to baseline than each of the three resistant samples on the primary RMS metric in both primary and vehicle-only baseline definitions
metrics.no_p_value: Only one regrowth genetic sample exists in the combined source; no inferential p-value is manufactured.

cross_level_adjudication.if_carrier_gate_passes: supports descriptive substrate/carrier persistence accompanying functional recovery despite mixed transcriptomic modal reorganization
cross_level_adjudication.if_carrier_gate_fails: carrier persistence is not established by direct VAF geometry and the cross-level Bio Chi interpretation remains RNA/behavior-only

forbidden: infer clone frequencies from SSM without running the source Pairtree model
select mutation subsets based on regrowth versus resistant separation
construct a scalar chi from VAF geometry
